passages.text: Of David.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was the king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David prayed to God.
David sang to God.

passages.text: To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul; in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David lifts up his soul to the LORD.
David trusts in God.
David asks God not to let him be put to shame.
David asks God not to let his enemies rejoice over him.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא׃ אֱ‍ֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל־ אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל־ יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי׃

passages.text: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who are faithless without cause will be disgraced.
passages.sermon:
God honors those who wait for Him.
No one who waits for God will be put to shame.
People who act without faith will be disgraced.
God will not let the faithless succeed.
passages.original: גַּ֣ם כָּל־ קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם׃

passages.text: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
passages.sermon: David speaks to the LORD.\r\nDavid asks the LORD to show him His ways.\r\nDavid asks the LORD to teach him His paths.
passages.original: דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
passages.sermon:
God is the God who saves me.
I wait for God all day long.
God, guide me in Your truth.
God, teach me.
passages.original: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ׀ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל־ הַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is compassionate and loving.
His compassion lasts forever.
His loving devotion endures through all generations.
LORD, remember Your compassion.
LORD, remember Your loving devotion.
passages.original: זְכֹר־ רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, You are good.
You show loving devotion.
Do not remember the sins I committed when I was young.
Do not remember my rebellious acts.
Remember me because of Your loving devotion.
Remember me because of Your goodness.
passages.original: חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י׀ וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל־ תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכָר־ לִי־ אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
passages.sermon: The LORD is good.\r\nThe LORD is upright.\r\nThe LORD shows sinners the way.
passages.original: טוֹב־ וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃

passages.text: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.
passages.sermon: The LORD is good and upright.\r\nThe LORD guides humble people in what is right.\r\nThe LORD teaches humble people His way.
passages.original: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is loving and faithful.
He acts with love and faithfulness in everything He does.
He shows this love and faithfulness to people who keep His covenant.
He also shows it to people who obey His decrees.
passages.original: כָּל־ אָרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker asks the LORD to forgive his iniquity.
The speaker says his iniquity is great.
The speaker asks for forgiveness for the sake of the LORD’s name.
passages.original: לְמַֽעַן־ שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב־ הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.
passages.sermon: A man fears the LORD.\r\nThe LORD instructs this man.\r\nThe LORD shows him the path He chooses for him.
passages.original: מִי־ זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר׃

passages.text: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.
passages.sermon: This man fears the LORD.\r\nHis soul will live in goodness.\r\nHis descendants will inherit the land.
passages.original: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
passages.sermon: The LORD is God.\r\nThe LORD confides in people who fear Him.\r\nThe LORD reveals His covenant to these people.
passages.original: ס֣וֹד יְ֭הוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם׃

passages.text: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
I look to the LORD at all times.
I keep my eyes on Him.
He will rescue me.
He will free my feet from every trap.
passages.original: עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא־ יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי׃

passages.text: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker asks the LORD to turn toward him.
The speaker asks the LORD to show him grace.
The speaker says he is lonely.
The speaker says he is afflicted.
passages.original: פְּנֵה־ אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי־ יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי׃

passages.text: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.
passages.sermon:
I feel many troubles in my heart.
These troubles keep growing.
I am in distress.
Please free me from my distress.
passages.original: צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתַ֗י הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is afflicted and troubled.
The speaker asks God to see this affliction.
The speaker asks God to see this trouble.
The speaker asks God to take away all his sins.
passages.original: רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכָל־ חַטֹּאותָֽי׃

passages.text: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David has many enemies.
These enemies hate David.
Their hatred is violent and cruel.
David asks God to see this.
passages.original: רְאֵֽה־ אוֹיְבַ֥י כִּי־ רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי׃

passages.text: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David asks God to protect his soul.
David asks God to save him.
David asks God not to let him be put to shame.
David trusts in God for safety.
passages.original: שָׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל־ אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי־ חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ׃

passages.text: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David asks God for help.
David wants God to protect him.
David says, "Let integrity preserve me."
David says, "Let uprightness preserve me."
David waits for God.
David trusts in God while he waits.
passages.original: תֹּם־ וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.
passages.sermon:
God, you are powerful.
\r\nIsrael is your chosen people.
\r\nIsrael faces many troubles.
\r\nGod, save Israel from every trouble.
\r\nGod, rescue Israel from all distress.
passages.original: פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָֽרוֹתָיו׃
